name: Dubwise FM
author: DocRuzzy
tagline: a dub mixing desk and riddim box for the FM-1
description: A reggae/dub groovebox where the mixing desk is the instrument: quantised mutes and solos, send throws into a feedback tape echo and a kickable spring, a stepped Big Knob filter, riddim templates and FM voices. Work in progress.
credits: Built on fm1-base (Charles Vestal) and felucca-bsp (Leo Kuroshita, Hügelton Instruments).
